sentiment.historyNote: Published CNN mirror observations, not a site-generated index; absent dates are not synthesized.

meta.source: Yahoo Finance public chart / FRED / CNN index via MacroMicro, CNN or public CNN mirror / Binance
meta.priceBasis: Yahoo Adj Close; independently verified cash distributions are backfilled only when the source lacks the ex-date adjustment. Raw quoted prices unchanged. Missing daily closes require a fully observed regular 30m session; prefer the timestamp-verified regular-session quote, otherwise its final 30m close. Only action-free or independently verified normal cash-dividend dates, explicitly flagged. Intraday: Yahoo Close.

verifiedDividendBackfills.basis: depositary-published provisional gross distribution absent from source adjustment

meta.dailyReconstructionPolicy: Complete observed regular 30m session required. Prefer a same-session regular quote stamped from the close through +300 seconds and observed at capture. Action-free unit factor, or independently verified cash dividend with unit/known matching factor; non-cash actions excluded. Provisional provenance retained.
meta.notice: Five-period weights inferred from public reference snapshots and rechecked through 2026-11-09; not an officially confirmed formula. Prices and runtime rankings are independently calculated from Yahoo. Long-term RS and historical ranks remain independent approximations.

marketCap.timing: Independent source observation; fetchedAt is retrieval time, not the equity close or a historical valuation.
